newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine judge sentences 3 kidnappers to death.
newsitem.headline: Philippine judge sentences 3 kidnappers to death.

text.p: A Philippine judge sentenced three people to death on Friday for killing a kidnapped 14-year-old Chinese-Filipino student after his parents failed to raise the three million peso ($113,850) ransom.

Judge Eliezer de los Santos of Angeles city in Pampanga, 80 km (49 miles) north of Manila, said the three accused were "sentenced to suffer the supreme penalty of death" for the crime of kidnapping for ransom and homicide.
The three abducted Arthur Tanhueco on July 5, 1995. They killed Tanhueco after his parents paid only 1.48 million pesos instead of the 3.0 million pesos ransom demanded.
"Imposing the death penalty on a murderer is not wrong, but required," de los Santos said.
The accused can still appeal to the appellate court. The death sentence also has to be confirmed by the Supreme Court.
